entry.description: When the send queue of `TelnetAppender`, `RemoteSyslogAppender` or the `SmtpAppender` of `log4net.Ext.Mail` is full, a logging call waits `EnqueueTimeoutMillis` once; later calls drop at once until a send succeeds, instead of each waiting the full timeout (ANT-2026-M13HDM0A, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
